```{r setup}
#| output: false

library(dplyr)
library(htmltools)
library(leaflet)
library(scales)

source("R/fetch_ndbc_observations.R")
source("R/plot_ndbc_field.R")
source("R/load_field_data.R")

sal_ndbc <- fetch_ndbc_hourly_snapshots(
  param = "sea_water_practical_salinity",
  value_col = "salinity"
)
temp_ndbc <- fetch_ndbc_hourly_snapshots(
  param = "sea_water_temperature",
  value_col = "temperature"
)

salinity_data <- sal_ndbc$latest |> filter(!is.na(salinity))
temperature_data <- temp_ndbc$latest |> filter(!is.na(temperature))

ref_date_label <- format(sal_ndbc$reference_date, "%Y-%m-%d")
data_as_of_label <- format_ndbc_time(sal_ndbc$data_as_of)
report_time <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z", tz = ndbc_display_tz)

salinity_fields <- interpolate_or_load_fields(
  sal_ndbc$snapshots,
  value_col = "salinity"
)
temperature_fields <- interpolate_or_load_fields(
  temp_ndbc$snapshots,
  value_col = "temperature"
)

salinity_palette <- c(
  "#2166ac", "#67a9cf", "#d1e5f0",
  "#fddbc7", "#ef8a62", "#b2182b"
)
temperature_palette <- c(
  "#313695", "#74add1", "#abd9e9",
  "#fee090", "#f46d43", "#a50026"
)

sal_range <- field_value_range(salinity_fields, "salinity")
temp_range <- field_value_range(temperature_fields, "temperature")
mean_salinity <- mean(salinity_data$salinity, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_temperature <- mean(temperature_data$temperature, na.rm = TRUE)
```

::: {.content-visible when-format="dashboard"}
Paired **salinity** and **temperature** maps from [SECOORA ERDDAP](https://erddap.secoora.org/erddap/index.html) buoys, interpolated with **DIVAnd** and bathymetry masking.
**Report:** `r report_time` · **Latest data:** `r data_as_of_label` · **Reference day:** `r ref_date_label`
:::

## Row {height=70%}

```{r latest-salinity-map}
#| title: Latest salinity
#| padding: 0px

if (nrow(salinity_data) == 0) {
  stop("No salinity data returned from ERDDAP.")
}

sal_pal <- colorNumeric(salinity_palette, salinity_data$salinity, na.color = "#999999")

leaflet(salinity_data) |>
  addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") |>
  setView(
    lng = mean(salinity_data$longitude),
    lat = mean(salinity_data$latitude),
    zoom = 9
  ) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~longitude,
    lat = ~latitude,
    radius = 8,
    stroke = TRUE,
    weight = 1,
    color = "#333333",
    fillColor = ~sal_pal(salinity),
    fillOpacity = 0.85,
    label = ~sprintf("%s: %.1f PSU\n%s", location, salinity, format_ndbc_time(time))
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = sal_pal,
    values = salinity_data$salinity,
    title = "Salinity (PSU)",
    opacity = 0.9
  )
```

```{r latest-temperature-map}
#| title: Latest temperature
#| padding: 0px

if (nrow(temperature_data) == 0) {
  stop("No temperature data returned from ERDDAP.")
}

temp_pal <- colorNumeric(
  temperature_palette,
  temperature_data$temperature,
  na.color = "#999999"
)

leaflet(temperature_data) |>
  addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") |>
  setView(
    lng = mean(temperature_data$longitude),
    lat = mean(temperature_data$latitude),
    zoom = 9
  ) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~longitude,
    lat = ~latitude,
    radius = 8,
    stroke = TRUE,
    weight = 1,
    color = "#333333",
    fillColor = ~temp_pal(temperature),
    fillOpacity = 0.85,
    label = ~sprintf("%s: %.1f °C\n%s", location, temperature, format_ndbc_time(time))
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = temp_pal,
    values = temperature_data$temperature,
    title = "Temperature (°C)",
    opacity = 0.9
  )
```

```{r paired-06}
#| title: 06:00 ET

plot_ndbc_hour_pair(
  salinity_fields[[1]],
  temperature_fields[[1]],
  sal_value_range = sal_range,
  temp_value_range = temp_range,
  sal_palette = salinity_palette,
  temp_palette = temperature_palette,
  show_sal_legend = TRUE,
  show_temp_legend = TRUE,
  show_hour_label = FALSE,
  label_fn = format_hour_panel_label
)
```
